measured_reported.instrument: JWST NIRSpec G140M/F100LP MOCSS; R about 1000; wavelength range 0.97-1.89 micron

derived_checks.instrumental_resolution_caveat: FWHM about 13.2 Angstrom is instrument-sensitive and must not be treated as a directly resolved intrinsic gas velocity; the paper quotes an unresolved width of order <=300 km/s.

model_competition.prediction: Detector-coordinate feature, extraction/CRDS sensitivity or unexpectedly high background false-positive rate emerges during independent raw replay.
model_competition.falsifier: Sky-fixed 16004A feature persists in individual raw exposures, both orientations and independently calibrated reductions with predeclared detection threshold.

model_competition.prediction: Extremely young metal-poor galaxy or transient H-alpha; discriminating H-beta/[OIII]/[NII] limits and contemporaneous continuum.
model_competition.falsifier: Decisive line-ratio or independently established redshift incompatible with z=1.44.

model_competition.prediction: [OIII] 4959 line near 15864A with approximately one third of 5008 flux and possible H-beta near 1.55 micron.
model_competition.falsifier: Deep calibrated upper bound excludes fixed 4959/5008 doublet ratio at a sufficiently sensitive threshold.

model_competition.prediction: [OII] doublet separation near 11.6 observed Angstrom; density and collisional quenching must explain narrow profile.
model_competition.falsifier: Resolved single-line profile incompatible with every physically allowed doublet ratio and instrumental line spread function.

model_competition.prediction: Reionization-era Ly-alpha transmission with a sufficiently large ionized bubble and extremely faint continuum; deep IFU spectral break test.
model_competition.falsifier: Identification of lower-redshift companion features, or Lyman break inconsistent with z about 12.16.

model_competition.prediction: Spatially offset line-emitting gas and one physically associated nearby ionizing host; IFU surface-brightness and redshift coherence.
model_competition.falsifier: Independent spectroscopy rules out spatial/redshift/energy compatibility for proposed illuminating hosts.

model_competition.prediction: Flux evolution on future epochs or retrospective light curve, and possible Pa-gamma/H-alpha companion constraints.
model_competition.falsifier: Demonstrably persistent continuum and line through the 2022 imaging epoch with no allowed transient profile.

selection_and_null_controls: Keep exposure time and observation opportunity distinct from detections.
Report 42 searched candidate lines and seven secure two-orientation matches; do not translate post-selection SNR to a global p-value without trials and correlated-noise model.
Inject synthetic lines into blind off-source shutters and nearby wavelengths to estimate detection/completeness and artifact rate.
Run detector-frame and sky-frame nulls, alternate reduction contexts, and cross-orientation wavelength consistency.
Maintain a time-indexed source/counterpart graph; the 2022 imaging is not same-epoch evidence against a 2023 transient.
Do not equate arXiv, journal paper, its figure, media repost and archive pointer to independent scientific witnesses.

experiment_backlog.procedure: Fetch GO-3290 MAST products and exposure metadata; pin pipeline 1.19 and CRDS jwst_1413.pmap as the published baseline; reproduce individual and coadded spectra with independent nulls.
experiment_backlog.pass: Sky-position and line centroid/flux consistent within declared errors across independent reductions and orientations.
experiment_backlog.fail: Feature fails preregistered sky-consistency or control tests.

experiment_backlog.procedure: Acquire or schedule deep imaging simultaneous with line spectroscopy and forced photometry at frozen coordinates.
experiment_backlog.pass: Quantified continuum detection or upper limit with the exact same temporal source state.

experiment_backlog.procedure: Request NIRSpec IFU field over fixed coordinates and neighboring galaxies, reaching flux sensitivity for [OIII] 4959, H-beta and Pa-gamma alternatives; predeclare model comparisons.
experiment_backlog.pass: One identifiable redshift or line-ratio model decisively survives published instrument/selection controls.
experiment_backlog.fail: Only same isolated line remains, yielding UNRESOLVED rather than exotic promotion.

experiment_backlog.procedure: Use subsequent multi-epoch spectra/photometry to fit and hold out SN, AGN-changing-look and TDE light curves without temporal data leakage.
experiment_backlog.pass: Calibrated, independent out-of-sample discrimination between persistent and transient regimes.

claim_ceiling: A robust reported emission line without a known 2022 imaging counterpart is neither a radio message nor an identified exotic source. Physical identity awaits independent spectral/temporal evidence.
